tools.name: get_workspace_summary
tools.description: Read one consistent current workspace snapshot. Requires workspaces.read and current canonical project access. Counts all active roles, participation and assignments without cursor truncation. Unknown headcount or unresolved role markers count once per role. Selection includes every active Option/Main/Backup assignment; Shortlist is explicit. Open slots have no Selection assignment, including provisional slots. Global library archival retains project participation. Unreviewed uses the Reviewed facts/source fingerprint and is null without cast.read. Ready entries retain every audience series, sorted by series_id; invalid pointers or more than 1000 Ready series fail explicitly. review_issue_count is always null. No mutation or provider call.

tools.name: get_feedback_summary
tools.description: Read full body-free feedback counts on the exact requested Ready version in one snapshot, without cursor/limit truncation. All actual slides appear in ordinal order, including zero cover rows. Pending slides have comments only. Count visible undeleted comment rows including replies, unresolved rows with resolved=false, and current stored votes by value. Totals sum per_slide; unresolved_count cannot exceed comment_count. No bodies, names or author/session identifiers. Signed-in authority remains workspaces.read plus current presentation/project scope; guest authority remains the existing live link/session/external-series checks and excludes all internal comment counts. No mutation or provider call.
